acceptance_criteria: Same tasks run with and without Hub using the same agent/model, prompts, repository revision, fixtures, and validation commands.
Record cloud input/output tokens, repeated tool-result tokens, tool-call counts, total completion time, validation success, and follow-up repairs per run.
Use separate authorized disposable roots and isolated Hub config/state; preserve run IDs and exact environment fingerprints.
Show no validation-quality regression and identify measurable token or time savings, or report neutral/negative results without retaining unsupported 80–95% claims.
Record evidence-bound results under docs/agent-evaluation/ and reconcile docs/TOKEN_ECONOMY.md.
task_p1_ab_evaluation.description: Run identical end-to-end coding tasks against a modern native-efficiency agent with and without Local AI Hub, using isolated roots and Hub state. Compare cloud input/output and repeated tool-result tokens, tool calls, duration, validation success, and follow-up repairs. Preserve honest neutral/negative results and revise unsupported savings claims.

Benchmark now reads /api/ps after inference, resets stale pre-request observations, and records context_qualification_status (verified/below_requested/unknown) plus context_qualified. Targeted regression suite: 26 passed. Full pytest is still running and has reported 5 failures so far; final classification pending.
task_p1_gpu_admission.description: Stress test RTX 5070 Ti (16GB VRAM). Hardware benchmark now accepts an optional bounded context_tokens value, forwards Ollama num_ctx, and returns actual backend prompt_eval_count. Explicit context requests require fresh VRAM budget evidence and must fit its dynamic context cap. Do not pull models.
task_p1_gpu_admission.next_action: Finish full pytest and classify failures. Then, with fresh Hub/GPU admission, rerun installed models at requested 8k/16k/32k and accept a context only when post-inference loaded_model_context_tokens >= requested_context_tokens. No model pulls.

Separate nonce-derived provider-session credential remains internal to provider serving. Tokenless/API focused suites pass: 212 passed, 1 skipped; context/transport subset 26 passed; isolated session/dashboard/SDK/identity subset 51 passed with one test updated and rechecked. Full pytest is not clean (10,383 passed, 179 failed, 72 errors, 109 skipped, 60 subtests passed) and pytest ended with Windows PosixPath internal error at 69%. No live OpenCode model→MCP→transactional edit→cleanup/recovery E2E has been recorded. Fresh readiness req_b09e75c9550e timed out for runtime and scheduler (gpu_admission_state unknown); reservation req_80b9b63e7c24 is free.
task_p2_opencode_e2e.description: Complete OpenCode runtime validation and remove the Hub API bearer-token system across the single-owner installation, as approved by the operator. Enforce loopback-only access and preserve command, capability, root, approval, lease, rate-limit and audit controls; retain only the separate nonce-scoped OpenCode provider credential.
